name: LifeSaver
tagline: A browser 3D operating room where students practise with webcam hand tracking and voice-guided anatomy.
problem: Medical trainees spend years watching before doing, and simulators are expensive.
solution: A Three.js operating room with instruments, MediaPipe hand tracking for interaction, voice guidance and a performance vector scoring technique, all in the browser.
demo_moment: Team-described: pick up an instrument with your hand and get scored.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Second Place Overall” and “Most Creative Hack” among 212 submissions.
No downloads or special hardware: a laptop and webcam.

lessons: Put an expensive training experience in the browser.
